# Sonar Studio

Sonar Studio is a solo, remote web studio based in Cyprus and working with businesses across the UK, Ireland and beyond.

The studio designs, builds and optimises websites so search engines and AI recommendation tools can understand what a business does, where it operates and why it is a credible answer.

## Primary services

- Essential: a fast website with AI-search and SEO foundations.
- Standard: a complete service-led website with booking and basic automation.
- Premium: advanced optimisation, content and AI automations.
- Care and Growth plans: ongoing hosting, maintenance, content and visibility work.

Sonar Studio is new and currently publishes one real case study. It does not guarantee rankings or AI recommendations and does not claim reviews, awards, client counts or statistics it cannot evidence.
